notes: Existing actions were checked before selecting candidates.
shake_hands is excluded because it already exists as the social rescue action.

MongoDB live vocabulary lookup was unavailable during one agent review; run a DB duplicate check before seeding.

candidates.visual_anchor: large flagpole inserted into a marked ground point
crown moves from chest height to the head and remains there
index finger and gaze stay locked on the same clue
risks: can read as waving or beckoning

candidates.visual_anchor: fingertips make brief contact without lifting the object
needs: wall mark, ice, stone, or key
risks: requires a medium shot for fingertip contact

candidates.visual_anchor: multiple stones are placed one above another and remain standing
risks: final stable result must remain visible

candidates.visual_anchor: sign loop aligns with a hook, then the sign hangs after hands release
two ends cross, form a loop, and tighten into a visible knot
broom head stays on the floor while leaves gather to one side
risks: dust movement may need a controlled effect

candidates.visual_anchor: character moves through at least three fixed trees with visible side-to-side path
risks: obstacles must stay fixed across frames

candidates.visual_anchor: horizontal body, alternating arm strokes, and arrival at the opposite bank
risks: can read as wading or floating
waterline and displacement must be clear

candidates.visual_anchor: hands and boots alternate across two or three low rubble levels
risks: can read as climbing or crawling
requires consistent hand and foot supports

candidates.visual_anchor: hands touch a low wall while both legs pass over to the far side
risks: can read as jumping or climbing

candidates.visual_anchor: head-first entry through a visible water surface followed by underwater alignment
risks: can read as jumping or falling

candidates.visual_anchor: large ribboned gift moves from giver's two hands to receiver's hands
risks: can read as generic handing over

candidates.visual_anchor: one arm rests around the partner's shoulder while both face the same direction
risks: character scale and shoulder height must match

candidates.visual_anchor: one character makes a clear 30-45 degree bow and waits for the other's softened response
open palm faces the approaching partner and the partner stops
brief shoulder and head jolt, followed by a cautious look toward the stimulus
needs: falling twig, sudden lamp, or moving door

candidates.visual_anchor: two small deliberate nods after looking at a clue
needs: map, rune, key, or footprint clue
risks: can read as greeting or sleepiness

candidates.visual_anchor: character leans toward a framed mirror with synchronized reflection

deferred_candidates.reason: high two-entity mouth, scale, gaze, and hand-food alignment risk
meaning depends too heavily on particles and target reaction
